description: Funds transfer where a TransferPolicy domain service owns the daily-limit rule that spans two Account aggregates and the transfer history, and the TransferFunds application service only loads, checks, applies and saves

hard.note: Business rules in a service class look like an anemic model or logic in an application service, but the rule spans two aggregates, so a domain service legitimately owns it, and the entities keep their own invariants
